reasoning: The PKGBUILD is a standard, safe AUR package. It downloads a pinned source tarball from the official GitHub repository and uses standard Meson build commands. There is no top-level code execution, no suspicious network requests, and no .install hooks or patches. The 'inconclusive' verdicts from other models were solely due to tool errors (API failures and content safety filter parsing errors), not actual security concerns.
